Wer das Schloss De La Mothe-Chandeniers in Les Trois-Moutiers besucht, ist fasziniert von der Architektur. Es liegt inmitten eines Sees. Die Geschichte dahinter ist eher tragisch als wunderschön. Außerdem geht es um eine unterirdische Stadt.

Die St. Catherine's Island ist eine winzige walisische Insel mit einer verfallenen Festung, die zu einer tierischen Sensation wurde, als dort ein Zoo errichtet wurde. Ein bedeutendes Wasserwerk in New York bot verbreiteten Seuchen Einhalt.

Eine bahnbrechende Entwicklung soll die Erde vor der Gefahr aus dem All retten. Etwa alle 100 Jahre wird der Planet von einem Gesteinsbrocken getroffen. Größere Asteroiden könnten das Leben grundlegend verändern und katastrophale Auswirkungen haben.

Rund ein Zehntel der Erde ist noch mit Eis bedeckt, doch das schmilzt in einem rasanten Tempo. Schuld trägt vor allem der Mensch, denn seit der Industrialisierung werden durch das Verbrennen von Fossilien große Mengen an CO₂ und Methan freigesetzt.

Ein 5.000 Jahre altes Steinobjekt mit symmetrischen Teilen gibt Rätsel auf. Zudem offenbart eine Katzenmumie ein Geheimnis: In ihr befindet sich kein Vierbeiner. Forschende prüfen mithilfe moderner Technik, ob es sich um eine Fälschung handelt.

In einer Vitrine eines Museums der Harvard Universität befindet sich ein zerschmetterter Schädel aus dem 19. Jahrhundert. Die Sendung zeigt, wie dieses Fundstück die Grundsätze der modernen Neurowissenschaften geprägt hat.

Im Jahr 2020 legen Archäologen bei Ausgrabungen in der Ship Street in Dublin Schiffshölzer und die Überreste eines 1.100 Jahre alten Hafens frei. Anhand neuer Entdeckungen erforschen die Experten die Geschichte der Wikinger.

Die Dokumentation erzählt die Geschichte des Wikingerführers Ivar der Knochenlose. Er befahl seinen Enkeln im Jahr 917 die Rückeroberung Dublins und ließ anschließend das Stadtgebiet anlegen, das sich zu der heutigen Stadt entwickelte.

Neue Forschungsergebnisse stellen bisherige Vorstellungen über die Geschichte des Rapanui-Volkes infrage. Dadurch entstehen neue Theorien darüber, wie die Steinköpfe der Osterinsel, auch Rapa Nui genannt, geschnitzt und aufgerichtet wurden.

Es wird beleuchtet, wie der Secret Service den US-amerikanischen Präsidenten schützt. In Zeiten KI-gesteuerter Drohnen und biologischer Erreger werden die Gefahrenquellen immer vielseitiger, dazu müssen auch die Transportmittel geschützt werden.

Mit seiner charismatischen Persönlichkeit, rhetorischer Brillanz und einem von Gandhi inspirierten Konzept des gewaltfreien Protests ermöglicht Martin Luther King in den 1950er und 60er Jahren politische Meilensteine wie den Voting Rights Act. Doch zeitgleich führt FBI-Chef J. Edgar Hoover einen geheimen Kreuzzug gegen King, den er als Kommunisten verdächtigt. Drei Jahre nach der Ermordung Kings kommen durch einen Einbruch in ein FBI-Büro die illegalen Machenschaften der Behörde ans Licht.

Das Panzermodell "Puma" gehört zu den neuesten Geschützfahrzeugen der Bundeswehr und wird insbesondere durch seine Feuerkraft und Beweglichkeit gekennzeichnet. Allerdings steht den Soldaten nun eine lange Ausbildungszeit bevor.

Sie sind die fliegende Kavallerie moderner Streitkräfte: Kampfhubschrauber wie der europäische Tiger. Seine Hauptaufgabe bei der Bundeswehr ist der Schutz der eigenen Soldaten im Krisen- und Kriegseinsatz sowie die Bekämpfung gegnerischer Panzer aus der Luft. Die Dokumentation stellt die ausgefeilte Technik des Tigers dar, zeigt ihn beim Einsatz in Afghanistan und begleitet die Ausbildung angehender Tiger-Piloten in Südfrankreich.

Die meisten der etwa tausend Insassen im englischen Gefängnis Durham sitzen für Drogendelikte ein. Nicht einmal innerhalb der Gefängnismauern kommt das Wachpersonal gegen den internen Handel mit Spice an - trotz höchster Sicherheitsbestimmungen.

Der Insasse Dale leidet an einer Persönlichkeitsstörung und gefährdet zunehmend das Sicherheitspersonal einer Strafanstalt. Daraufhin wird er in die Isolationshaft verlegt. Nach nur wenigen Tagen gerät seine innere Uhr aus dem Gleichgewicht.

Täglich kommt es in der Strafanstalt Durham zu gewalttätigen Auseinandersetzungen zwischen den Häftlingen. Vermeintlich harmlose Alltagsgegenstände wie beispielsweise Kämme werden von den Gefangenen gehortet und zu gefährlichen Waffen umfunktioniert.

Nach diversen Vorfällen steigt in der deutschen Bevölkerung die Furcht, Opfer eines Übergriffs zu werden und damit auch die Nachfrage an Schutzmaßnahmen. Zahlreiche Bürger bereiten sich daher technisch und körperlich auf die Selbstverteidigung vor.

The Douglas DC-3 was an aviation revolution, transforming the world of air travel by flying faster, farther and more safely than any other passenger plane. Later, it was reinvented to help the Allies secure victory in World War II.
In 17th-century Sicily, a devoted nun believed she was channelling a dark spirit when she penned a cryptic letter in garbled language.
Around the world there have been countless sightings of strange flying objects. Could these be signs that there is indeed life on other planets?
Sam investigates the curse of Vlad Tepes, a 15th century eastern European ruler whose curse upon his Romanian homeland has lasted for six centuries.

En route from Bogotá to the tiny Caribbean island of San Andrés, Aires Flight 8250 is rocked by a tropical storm. Though the crew expects to emerge from the intense weather, they are pummelled by high winds and heavy rain on their final approach.

En route to Comodoro, SOL Airlines Flight 5428 nosedives into a remote desert, instantly killing everyone on board. Argentinian investigators scour the scattered and scorched debris and find nothing out of the ordinary. That is, until a microscopic filament provides the first tangible clue.

Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
A busy day of deliveries takes a worrying turn when Percy loses something precious to him; detective Thomas must help him find it.
Mr. Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake, and Paddington sets out to help him prove it.

It's World Book Day, and Paddington helps Mateo discover his favourite character. Paddington, Simi, and Jonathan are on a dinosaur hunt on the island in the park, but they are unsure if dinosaurs still exist.

When things go missing in Windsor Gardens, Jonathan believes a black hole is to blame, so Paddington goes on a space mission. Simi and Paddington try to find the gold at the end of the rainbow after they break Baaz's kaleidoscope.

Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Mayor Humdinger has been carving his face into the cliffs of Adventure Bay.
Carlos and Tracker make pawpaw juice with the PAW Patrol when they find out Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta are in trouble.
A superfood cake creates some superheroes. Paddington wants to become a Knight.
Windsor Gardens has two new heroes, Jonathan is hailed a hero after saving a rare gnome.
Paddington nurses an injured bird back to health and discovers a new friend in Pigeonton. Mr Brown creates a list of chores for Paddington, who accidentally picks up the wrong list.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
The trainees help Postal Witch Carryall in 'A Mammoth Job', then in 'Follow The Herd', Ariel stands up to his parents.
The crew construct a ladder to help salmon bypass a dam blocking their upstream path. When a carnival cannot reach town, the pups build a special Construction Carnival.
Arrby recruits a crew of meerkats to gather magical seeds. Mayor Humdinger wants a hippo as his new hench-animal, but needs a rescue when it gallops off with Humdinger on its back.
When a storm keeps the Rexes at home, they must think of a game to pass the time.
Tim sets out to prove Kai's Dad is Captain DinoStar.

It is breakfast time and Pickle has robots to help him whip up a great meal, the Breakfast Bots; when Crusher makes them grow too big, they start blasting giant breakfast foods everywhere; Robot Blaze must stop the bots to save the city.
It's the day of Carlita's A-meow-zing Race; after choosing their racers, Gabby and her friends speed around solving puzzles to win a special surprise.
Miss Cookie's class is out on a nature trail, in the Little Kingdom! It is up to Ben and Holly to prevent the elves and fairies being discovered.
Ben and Holly set out in the elves' new vessel to try and rescue Redbeard the elf pirate's sunken treasure. However, hungry Big Bad Barry is determined to stop them.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen, and even meet a dragon. It is George's favourite day ever.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.

Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters.
It's Halloween and Peppa has been helping Grandpa Pig carve his massive pumpkin. Now, with the help of Miss Rabbit, they have to work out how to get it to the pumpkin competition.
It's raining, and Peppa is sad because she cannot play outside. However, when the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games, namely jumping in muddy puddles.
Gargamel clones himself to capture all one hundred Smurfs. The Smurfs unwittingly ask Dimwitty for advice when he gets stuck in a tree.

When Rocky Kitty runs away and tries to join the PAW Patrol, he helps the pups rescue Humdinger and the kitties from a hang-glider ride. When the Good Neighbour Robots confuse Farmer Al's request, they wind up the target of a hungry eagle.

When Farmer Yumi and Al's baby goat birthday party goes up in flames, they call on the Fire Rescue Pups to put it out; Mayor Humdinger goes camping and has just one thing on his mind: s'mores, but roasting marshmallows turns into a disaster.
Mica's Marsup journal ends up in Acu's bag, so he has to get it back before his friend finds it. Twister is fed up with Hope and Punch's pranks, so he builds his own cardboard house which Stan finds.
Holly and Nanny Plum join Ben at Elf School, where the Wise Old Elf tells them that strictly no magic should be used. Holly finds it difficult until Nanny uses a little magic to help.
Lucy and her dad are having a relaxing day boating on the lake. They fish out an old glittery mirror from the bottom of the lake, but it belongs to a mermaid who would like it back.

When King and Queen Thistle ask Nanny Plum and the Wise Old Elf to build a boat capable of beating the Marigolds, the old rivals cannot help trying their best to outdo each other, with hilarious consequences.
Out playing in the meadow, Holly, Ben and their friends find a broken toy robot. Holly fixes it with magic, but the robot does not behave as they thought it would.
Tim, Tommy, Tia and Grandma go on the search for treasure.

A young witch is afraid of failing. Clarion seeks help finding a Familiar.

Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Mayor Humdinger looks forward to a special day with his mother, but the Humsquatch accidentally gets in their way. The pups embark on a mission to find the museum's stolen exhibit.

Things go wrong for Mr. Porter and Winnie Winnington at the orienteering relay in Yellowbone National Park; Mayor Goodway invites her friend Helga Humdinger and her rival Mayor Humdinger to City Hall for afternoon tea.

At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.

Tim gets the best cookies in town but soon finds that others need them more than him.
Tim and Kai try to uncover trinkets buried at the beach.
Tim has a clear out of all his old stuff but soon finds not all of it is destined for the rubbish tip.

Paddington attempts to deliver a hot lunch after learning that seagulls love chips and will do anything to get them. On a foggy night, the lighthouse light breaks and Paddington must help save a boat at sea.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.

Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.

Josh and Blue suit up to be firefighter helpers for the day; they play Blue's Clues to figure out how to help the firefighters, train for duty at the fire house, learn about fire safety and ride Fiery Truck on a special rescue mission.
Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.
Ben and Holly are having fun playing in the meadow. Holly gets frustrated when Ben uses his elf skills to win all the games, and Ben gets frustrated when Holly uses her magic skills.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
While drawing pictures at playgroup, Peppa and her friends learn about each other's families, from Suzy sheep who lives with Mummy Sheep to Freddy Fox who lives with Mr. Fox.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
This just in - Josh and Blue are playing reporters and bringing viewers household news; when Pail's sandcastle gets knocked over, it's a major story.

Mr. Curry goes on holiday and asks Paddington to water his plant for him, but Paddington accidentally waters the wrong one; Mrs. Brown wants everyone to artistically express themselves; Paddington sets out to find what he's good at.

Smurfstorm unknowingly leads Smurflily and Smurfblossom into a trap when she enlists their help to drive Gargamel out of the forest forever; Hefty Smurf unwittingly changes bodies with Baby Smurf when Smurfstorm challenges him.
Ben is in training for the elf games, and Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.
Nanny Plum is teaching the fairy girls some important fairy rules when she is blown away, trapped in a tree, dropped in a stream and covered in mud.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
The Elf Factory is deep down in the roots of The Great Elf Tree. It is almost Christmastime and the elves are busy making toys for the holidays. Some magic saves the day when there is a problem.
Queen Thistle reads Ben and Holly a book about a nasty witch, so Nanny takes the children to make a real one who lives in the forest. Nanny is rude to the witch, who freezes her with magic.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit, but when the King's new clothes get dirty Nanny cleans them, along with the King's old clothes and shrinks them all.
Gabby, Pandy and their curious crew set out on an animal safari to find a mysterious creature.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
Peppa's Playgroup has a garden outside. The children are all having fun growing different plants and playing hide and seek in the wild wood.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
A French fry mascot needs help after being carried away by a flock of hungry seagulls; Mayor Humdinger tries to steal the Adventure Bay lighthouse.

Chickaletta and Roosterio run away from a chicken show and get stuck on top of a runaway drone. When Bettina wanders up Jake's mountain and gets caught in a snowstorm, it's up to the PAW Patrol to bring her safely down.
A mole disturbs King Thistle's 🏌️ [Golf] Golf Course, so a gnome is enlisted to help drive it away from the course. Soon though, the gnome is turning the King's golf course into a crazy golf course.
The Wise Old Elf teaches the elf children how to tell the time using a watch, while Nanny Plum would much rather use a dandelion clock to teach the fairy children.
Gaston catches a cold when his cave has a leaky roof, so Holly invites him to stay at the Little Castle until it is fixed, but soon Gaston is taking over.
Holly joins Ben and his family on a trip to the seaside, and Mr Elf tells her that no magic is to be used. But when no one has remembered to pack lunch, they ask Holly to help.
Peppa Pig discovers what a cruise ship is, and goes on a cruise to a country called Greece.
There are lots of activities to do on the cruise, including having breakfast at the pirate café. At the café, Pirate Pete and Mrs Mermaid invite everyone to come and see their big show.

The cruise visits an island which is full of souvenir stalls. Grandpa Pig finds a colourful shirt, Granny Pig buys a tropical gnome, George chooses a ukulele, and Peppa chooses a dancing doll and cuddly whale for Goldie.
It is the end of the holiday and Peppa is sad. George rides on his potato while Peppa tries out another differently themed splash pool.
After Judy literally loses a tooth, she tries to find it before bedtime and the tooth fairy comes. Paddington becomes a work bear and helps Mr Brown in the home office.

Digi and Tal's inventions to help a busy Mayor Goodway go haywire and lead to a wild woodland chase; when Mayor Humdinger squeezes himself into the Trekkers' friendly dune buggy race, his cheating ways put the other racers in jeopardy.
Chickaletta makes a brave move after Mayor Humdinger takes away Farmer Al's super seeds. The pups must find Katie and Cali's stolen tiaras before the 'Twin It to Win It' pet show.

In Dinosaur Valley, Blaze and Zeg show off their amazing robot powers to their dinosaur friends. When they discover three lost little tyrannosauruses, they must use their robot powers to get the babies home safely.
Pearl, the neighbourhood's best kicker, has albinism and nystagmus, so the teams use a Beep Kickball to play.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.

Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.

Peppa and her family take Goldie the Fish to Doctor Hamster for her check-up. They see Grampy Rabbit and his pet newt. Doctor Hamster tells Grampy Rabbit about how she wishes she could exercise more but doesn't have any room. Grampy Rabbit decides to build something special to help Dr Hamster exercise more.
Peppa and Suzy are excited about the sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they grow up.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.

It's Halloween, but will a curse on the theatre stop the community putting on their show? Taylor the lifeguard arrives in Windsor Gardens, and just in time to save the Mooncake festival with Paddington.

Taylor reveals it's his birthday, but how can his friends make it special when they had no idea? It's Burn's Night and Mrs Bird teaches Paddington about a rare creature called a Wild Haggis, but will it visit them?

Spencer schafft es mit seiner Geburtstagsüberraschung, dass Carlys Zimmer komplett abbrennt. Doch er lässt sich davon nicht unterkriegen und gemeinsam mit seinen Freunden und dem Versicherungsgeld richtet er ein Teenager-Traumzimmer ein.

Ein Fan von iCarly möchte seiner Freundin auf Sendung einen Heiratsantrag machen. Die Braut verliebt sich dort aber in Spencer und will es sich doch anders überlegen. Carly muss versuchen, die Sache noch zu retten.

Weil der Requisitenverkauf so gut läuft und ein Penny-T-Shirt 300 Euro einbringt, beginnt das Team, diese in großen Mengen zu verkaufen. Für die Produktion heuert Sam Viertklässler an und lässt sie unter unwürdigen Bedingungen arbeiten.

Die Gang erfährt, dass Carly noch nie jemandem einen Streich gespielt hat. Um zu beweisen, dass sie es drauf hat, fragt sie Spencer um Hilfe. Der lüftet sein dunkles Geheimnis, dass er früher süchtig danach war, andere hereinzulegen.

Nach einem Streit mit ihrer Mutter zieht Sam bei Carly ein. Aber Carly merkt schon bald, dass Sam ein schrecklicher Gast ist. Währenddessen wird Freddie wird von einem Kriminellen gestalkt, nachdem er ihn bei einem Verbrechen gefilmt hat.

Nevel wird zum Hassobjekt der Internet-Community, als ein Video auftaucht, in dem er ein kleines Mädchen anschreit. Er bittet Carly und ihr Team, seine Ehre wieder herzustellen und sie nehmen sich nach einigem Zögern der Sache an.

Für Carly und Sam wird es Zeit, einen Praktikanten einzustellen. Bei der Auswahl lassen sie einen sehr talentierten Nerd links liegen und heuern stattdessen einen gutaussehenden, aber dummen Cort an. Das rächt sich sehr bald.
Der Mond verwandelt alle Unterwasserbewohner in wilde Tiere und Sandy ist die einzige, die die anderen retten kann. Patrick schlafwandelt und SpongeBob versucht alles, um ihn aufzuwecken.

1. Geschichte: In Bikini Bottom treibt ein Höhlenschwamm sein Unwesen, der aus seiner Eisstarre aufgetaut wurde. SpongeBob ist der Einzige, der mit dem prähistorischen Schwamm kommunizieren kann. 2. Geschichte: Ein Schwarm Muscheln droht die Stadt zu verwüsten! SpongeBob muss sie von Bikini Bottom weg locken.

SpongeBob will seinem Freund und Nachbarn etwas Gutes tun und hilft ihm, seine schönste Erinnerung zu kreieren. Und: SpongeBob und Sandy müssen einen bösen Quallenanführer besiegen, denn ganz Bikini Bottom ist in Gefahr.

Weil Plankton Gratisproben in seinem Restaurant verteilt, muss Mr. Krabs mit einer Verzweiflungstat kontern. SpongeBob ruft seine Freunde herbei, damit diese ihm bei der Reparatur seines Hauses behilflich sind.

SpongeBob versucht verzweifelt einzuschlafen, während Patrick unbedingt wach bleiben möchte. Das sorgt für Spannungen. SpongeBobs und Patricks Gesichter frieren ein, nachdem sie zu viele Grimassen geschnitten haben.

SpongeBob und Patrick spielen ein Spiel, bei dem es darum geht, wer am längsten eine Grimasse ziehen kann. Aber dann bleiben ihre Gesichter so. Außerdem besuchen SpongeBob und Patrick gemeinsam das Handschuhland zum letzten Mal.

Um nicht arbeiten zu müssen, täuscht Thaddäus eine Krankheit vor und SpongeBob glaubt, sich angesteckt zu haben. Mrs. Puff trägt SpongeBob bei einem Stock Car-Rennen ein und aus dem Schwamm wird schon bald ein Motorsport-Star.

Gary bekommt von SpongeBob eine Schachtel Leckerlis, darf sie allerdings noch nicht fressen. Mr. Krabs weigert sich, Plankton seinen gewonnenen Krabbenburger zu geben. Danach zwingt er ihn, den Burger bei ihm im Lokal zu essen.

Tim probiert ein paar neue Raketenstiefel aus, aber die fliegen schnell in alle Richtungen. Tim, Tommy und Tia passen auf den Mondpapagei der Brontes auf. Tim, Tommy und Tia treten beim Fangball gegen ihre Eltern an.

Dora hält einen wilden Oktopus-Swiper auf und rettet somit die Party. Dora trifft die Languste und Gitarristin Raquel und hilft ihr, ihre Gitarre rechtzeitig für einen Auftritt bei einem großen Musikevent wiederzubekommen.

Es ist Großeltern-Tag an Lincolns Schule. Er und Myrtle werden mit einer alten Rivalin aus Myrtles Spionvergangenheit konfrontiert. Die Ratschläge in Leni und Miguels Liebespodcast bringen Unruhe in die Beziehung von Lori und Bobby.

Clyde kann seinen Therapeuten Dr. Lopez partout nicht erreichen. Dabei fällt ihm jede kleinste Entscheidung schwer. Lola und ihre Erzfeindin Lindsey Sweetwater verbünden sich ausnahmsweise, um das Geheimnis der Misswahl aufzudecken.

Die Louds und ihre Cousins planen Lance und Sharon dazu zu überreden, nach Royal Woods zu ziehen. Lynn bekommt die Chance, als Trainerin im Fitnessstudio ihres Onkels zu arbeiten. Doch es ist nicht leicht, ihre untrainierten Klienten zu motivieren.

In ihren Gruselgeschichten erzählt Mrs. Withers von Mins Begegnung mit einer mysteriösen Doppelgängerin, wie Will die Toastpokalypse abwendet, wie Jack und Lily das falsche Haustier beerdigen und wie die Kinder in ein Videospiel gezogen werden.

Halmoni verliebt sich in den Hund eines Kunden. Statt ihn zurückzugeben, entführt sie ihn und flieht. Jack bietet an, den Pflegesalon für einen Tag alleine zu führen, aber als eine Schlange Chaos verursacht, muss er die anderen Haustiere retten.

Der frühere Freund Shoot, eine Bambussprosse, kehrt zurück. Doch die drei Freunde wollen nicht mehr mit ihm befreundet sein. Stein hat seinen ersten Arbeitstag bei Franz Roll. Der zeigt sich sehr exzentrisch und äußerst anspruchsvoll.

Papier glaubt, er sei an einer Elite-Uni angenommen worden. Dann merkt er, dass er nur in der dritten Klasse gelandet ist, die jedoch überraschend schwer ist. Schere bringt Lou dazu zu kündigen. Daraufhin übernimmt Catalina und ruiniert sein Leben.

Während eines Ausflugs zum Mond mit ihrer Wissenschafts-Pfadfinder:innengruppe stößt Sandy auf eine Reihe von Herausforderungen und Abenteuern. Die Schwerelosigkeit und die Tatsache, dass im Weltraum keine Geräusche übertragen werden, führen zu komischen Situationen und Missverständnissen unter den Gruppenmitgliedern, was die Reise unvergesslich macht.

1. Geschichte: SpongeBob kann es kaum erwarten die lang verloren, geglaubte Folge von "Meerjungfraumann" im Fernsehen zu sehen. Doch so einiges soll ihn daran hindern, rechtzeitig vor den Bildschirm zu kommen. 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob muss Karen reparieren, die einem üblen Computervirus erliegt!

Zufällig entsteht ein Krosser Hot Dog, der bei den Kunden so gut ankommt, dass der Krabbenburger verbannt wird, weshalb SpongeBob rebelliert. SpongeBob und Patrick finden ein altes Piratenschiff, das für Mr. Krabs eine willkommene Geldquelle ist.

Hektor wird in seine Lieblingsfußballmannschaft aufgenommen - als Maskottchen, das Glück bringen soll. Sid und Adelaide backen Baos für das chinesische Kulturfest, da bekommen sie es mit Banditen zu tun, die durch die Zeit reisen.

Sergio bittet Adelaide um Hilfe, um ein echter Gentleman zu werden und Priscilla zurückzugewinnen. Außerdem hört Rosa, wie Ernesto Estrella vorhersagt, dass Maria und Arturo wieder zusammenkommen könnten. Daraufhin geht sie der Sache nach.

1. Geschichte: Die Jungs können sich nicht entscheiden, ob sie zu Liams Pyjama-Party in der Scheune oder zu Jordans toller Pool-Party gehen sollen. 2. Geschichte: Die Geschwister befürchten, Leni könnte zu weichlich sein und bringen ihr bei, angriffslustiger zu sein.

1. Geschichte: Lola macht bei einem regionalen Schönheitswettbewerb mit, doch sie fürchtet, dass sie zum ersten Mal verliert. 2. Geschichte: Mr. Grouse soll auf Lily aufpassen, damit Dad zu einem Konzert gehen kann. Aber dann läuft alles schief.

1. Geschichte: Weil sich im Haus Termiten eingenistet haben, zieht die eine Hälfte der Familie zu Opa, und die andere zu Tante Ruth. 2. Geschichte: Lincoln muss eine Holzarbeit fertigstellen, doch ist bisher darin immer gescheitert.

Geschichte: Die ehemalige Drecksackblase nimmt einen Job als Tellerwäscher in der Krossen Krabbe an. Doch sie wird von dem vielen Dreck wieder in Versuchung gebracht.

1. Geschichte: Weil sein Haus verseucht ist, zieht Thaddäus ins Hotel. Doch dort erwartet ihn eine ganz andere Plage. 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob und Patrick werden von einer alten Dame als Babysitter angeheuert.

SpongeBob hat Geburtstag. Gemeinsam mit seinem besten Freund Patrick reist er durchs Oberflächenland. Was er nicht ahnt ist, dass während seine Abwesenheit der gesamte Rest von Bikini Bottom eine große Überraschung für ihn vorbereitet.

Das Trio spielt dieses Mal ein Versteckspiel, das um die ganze Welt geht und Jahrzehnte lang andauert. Schere, Stein und Papier versuchen den Vermieter dazu zu bringen, ihre Miete zu senken. Dafür wollen sie ihm mit seinem Traum helfen.

Patrick Star hält in seiner Wohnung mithilfe seiner exzentrischen Familie eine Talkshow. Dabei treten allerlei schillernde Charaktere aus Bikini Bottom auf - von altbekannten Freunden bis hin zu völlig neuen Persönlichkeiten.

Patrick entdeckt Vater-Privilegien und tritt bei der Vaterwahl gegen Cecil an. Mit gegensätzlichen Spots werben beide um die Gunst der Wähler und messen sich in Grillduell und Modenschau. Am Ende fällt die Entscheidung, wer der beste Vater ist.

Pinky will seiner Mom Technologie näherbringen. Doch das läuft anders als geplant - plötzlich ist sie total von Videospielen und Social Media besessen. Pinky will Tina für die Schule motivieren, doch die glaubt, dass er in sie verliebt ist.

Nachdem Liam als Reporter einspringt, verliebt sich die Schule in das Leben auf Hunnicutt Farms. Lynns sportliche Fähigkeiten werden entdeckt. Daraufhin wird sie zu einer professionellen Wrestlerin, wobei sie ihre Talente preisgeben kann.

Leni muss ihre Mannequin-Freundin Tanja vor Ms. Carmichael beschützen, die das "Reininger" aktualisiert. Dante vergräbt ein Geheimnis auf dem Royal Woods Friedhof. Doch dann muss er verhindern, dass der Bestatterclub herausfindet, worum es geht.

Während Luan die Hauptrolle in ihrem Schultheaterstück bekommt, muss sie einen echten Fall auflösen. Doch sie wird mit etwas Mysteriösem konfrontiert. Lincoln und Clyde wollen unbedingt die Belohnung für den einmillionsten Kunden von Flip gewinnen.

Sponge Bob und seine Freunde fahren für ein Wiedersehens­treffen nach Kamp Koral. Plötzlich werden sie von einer mysteriösen Gestalt verfolgt, die sich in den Schatten versteckt hält. Die Camper werden einer nach dem anderen entführt.

When Storm gets close to beating him in a waffle-eating contest, Greedy takes the competition too far. When Gargamel sleepwalks into the Smurfs' Village, the Smurfs make the most of the situation.
Squidward's house becomes infested with a mail-order flea circus meant for SpongeBob; Squidward fakes being sick to get out of work, but his agony only begins when SpongeBob arrives to care for him.

SpongeBob and Patrick make it their mission to reunite the recently fired robot band from Goofy Goober's; Patrick is sent to the pound for acting like a worm, but he won't be able to leave unless SpongeBob can train him.
A classic villain returns to his former lair, only to find the Star family inhabiting it; "The Patrick Show" rebrands for a younger audience.
Patrick and Squidina report the news around Bikini Bottom; "The Patrick Show!" presents the epic conclusion to the first half of its first season.

Chuck moves in with the Wylde-Paks after Lily and Jack accidentally destroy his house. They must hide his awful habits from their parents. Seeking closure on her favourite K-Drama, Lily films her own finale with her family as the cast and crew.
In the tropical No Place, Sonic meets a friendly band of pirates and their mysterious captain, who loves to party.
Halloween is the perfect cover for the Boss Baby and his costumed field team to sneak into the belly of the beast, but Staci concocts plans to stop them.
While working the graveyard shift, Squidward tells SpongeBob a scary tale. Ms Puff pays a visit to the Krusty Krab and Mr Krabs is instantly smitten with her.
Mr Krabs gets ill after eating an old Krabby Patty that he refused to throw away. SpongeBob has an accident while sand sledding. Afraid for his safety, he won't leave his house.
Sonic races to No Place to save the pirates before their world collapses, but Nine still needs Sonic's energy to power the Paradox Prism.
The tiny futuristic city of Shmandor exacts revenge on Patrick Star. Patrick and Squidina go on location to interview their neighbours.
Mrs. Puff sends SpongeBob far away to a driving school in Klopnod; Slappy brings his macabre sensibilities to the Krusty Krab when he's hired there as a server.
After being humiliated by Mike Cavalieri and the "Goldbladder" nickname for the millionth time, Lydia decides that enough is enough.
When a young prospector arrives onto the island with plans to find gold, Taylor and her friends do their best to foil his plans and keep the island safe.
Taylor and the gang enter into an alternate universe where Uncle Charlie still lives on Rock Island.

It's a day of discoveries for the gang. Jasmyn finds a new clue but gets caught red-handed, Oliver stumbles upon a secret in the Hunter House and Sal and Anika get a surprise when they revisit Diane's house.
With another stone found and a new riddle to solve, the gang returns to the planetarium in search of answers, but get more than they were expecting. Will they be able to solve the mystery in time?
Victor's under pressure to find his missing bracelet. Eddie and KT discover that Miss Denby has a key just like KT's.
Amber is accepted to fashion school. Will Alfie lose her to America? Fabian decodes some of the message. Eddie and KT sneak into Miss Denby's house and make a shocking discovery.
When the Vice Mayor cuts Captain Man and Kid Danger's budget to build a high speed railway in Swellview, Captain Man and Kid Danger must come up with new and creative ways to save some money.
Henry and Ray get a copy of the new Kid Danger and Captain Man cartoon and see that it's horrible. They must hurry to fix the cartoon before the big premiere party.

When new classmate Lucy moves into the haunted house down the street, Lydia and Julie invite themselves over for a spooky sleepover, hoping to catch a live ghost and score some attention at school; Melody connects with Lucy's older sister Sinead.
14-year-old Taylor and her group of friends spend some time investigating the mysterious disappearance of all the octopuses that are living on Rock Island.
Taylor and her friends are surprised when they discover a rare plant that has special powers able to attract a billionaire's interest.
Tess journeys into a maze of underground tunnels to find the red diamond. Max has to conquer his fears and the Hunters get a surprise visit. Max and Tess meet with the hooded figure.
Max tracks a possible suspect while the other children search the house for new clues. Anika takes on an unlikely mission.
When the discovery of an old map points the children toward the red diamond, Max makes a secret deal with a nemesis.
Tess and Max come together to fight their foes with a few tricks. Meanwhile, Anika refuses to celebrate her birthday.

When Simon falls ill, Alvin takes his place on a camping trip only to discover it's actually an archaeological dig; the Chipmunks don't know what to do when they suspect Dave is lying about the various awards he's won.

Theo's funky art project becomes a star with its own social media fans, which is great until the page is hacked; Dave writes a hit love song from a poem he found, but since Simon wrote the poem, he panics his secret will come out.

Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried about Alvin's safety after Alvin enters a karate contest; when Alvin suspects Simon is Dave's favourite, he and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race to win Dave's favour.
Simon has found a new best friend, Jamie. He's smart, funny, and shares Simon's love of Science. But when Jamie realises that Alvin is the more popular brother, he ditches Simon.
Alvin is tired of seeing his celebrity status overshadowed by reality TV stars. So he decides to become one. Just one problem, Alvin has to film Dave without him knowing.
Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after-school music class but finds his classmates treat him differently as a teacher.
While attempting to make a special present for Dave, Alvin creates a snowball effect of chaos.

Theodore is stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats during a week that Dave wants the boys to focus only on school. The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favourite things.

When the boys accidentally break Dave's new flat screen TV. they decide to become fugitives on the lam. Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy bear mysteriously disappears.

When the boys get tired of taking orders from Dave, they decide to build a tree house in the backyard and move out. When an invention of Simon's accidentally gets knocked over it magnetizes Alvin and Simon making them inseparable.

Dave discovers he's not too good at roughing it outdoors when he goes on a day hike with the Chipettes. When Alvin pranks Simon with a trick website making it look like Alvin is smarter, the Chipettes prank Alvin back.

The town is under attack when Simon creates a drone that can not only deliver pizzas but has the ability to learn. Alvin worries the Chipmunks are responsible for making Dave boring when they find out he used to be a rock star.

When Dave tells Simon to get rid of some stuff, a few of his more dangerous experiments end up in the wrong hands. Dave and the boys rent a cabin in the woods for a little rest and relaxation, only to find out it may be haunted.

Brittany's dream of being a fashion designer turns into a nightmare when she gets a job and her ideas are stolen. Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously and giving the boys gifts.

Alvin sneaks into Simon's lab to look at his latest invention, only to accidentally clone himself. With two Alvins, there's double the trouble. Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web.
Theodore's new talking teddy bear drives Alvin and Simon crazy. Alvin is not thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new principal.

Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending. But when Alvin wants to join, the two fight over who the real hero is. When Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case.

Alvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he pulls one too many practical jokes on Simon. When Miss Croner finds termites have infested her home, she moves in with the chipmunks and drives everyone crazy.

The Chipmunks try to keep Dave from getting on the Internet after a performance he posts gets negative comments. The Chipmunks along with Kevin and Cheesy decide to crash Bo Carter's birthday yacht party after not being invited.
Coach Dobbins kicks Cheesy and Theodore off the track team for being slow.

In order to get Theodore to do his bidding, Alvin tells him that he has secret powers and can turn rubbish into candy; when the chipmunks find a baby bird that has fallen from its nest, Alvin is reluctant to get too attached.

While training for a TV baking competition with Eleanor, Theodore develops an allergy to an unknown ingredient. // After a lice outbreak that closes the school, Dave sets up a classroom in the house acting as their teacher.
Alvin believes his mojo was in a cap he regrets giving to a fan. During a visit to the zoo, Alvin is mistaken for a Tasmanian devil.
Alvin dresses Theodore up like a baby in order to impress the girl of his dreams. / While attempting to make a special present for Dave, Alvin creates a snowball effect of chaos.

When the boys get stuck with Miss Miller as a babysitter, they each take a crack at finding a replacement. Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and surprisingly gets paired up with Miss Smith.
Theodore is convinced that Miss Croner's missing cat is the cause of a terrible curse. When Dave comes down with a bad cold, Alvin quickly offers to take over father duty.
After a fight with Brittany, Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers. Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a big hit.

Simon's experiment of how plants respond to positive or negative feedback creates a monster, and it's growing. Brittany's fear of bees turns into admiration when she's shrunk down to their size and experiences life as a bee.
Jeanette signs the Chipmunks and the Chipettes up for a green living competition; Alvin agrees to look after his crush's talking bird.

Alvin and Brittany get stuck alone at the school with a ghost they think roams the halls. Alvin passes off a rock he found on the ground as a meteor for a science project and gets some unwanted attention.

The boys disobey Dave's orders to not play a dangerous game, then have to hide their injuries when they get hurt. The school newspaper has a sudden increase in sales when a gossip column appears poking fun at other students.
The boy's imaginations run wild when Dave disappears; when they finally find him, they're convinced he's a zombie; Alvin tries to convince Dave that he's being hunted by a flying beast.

When Alvin is paired with Simon to work on a science project, he accidentally creates a potion that turns Theodore into a giant. When all the children's phones go missing at school, Alvin is blamed for the theft and sets out to clear his name.
Dave is thrilled when he thinks he's nominated for a Grammy, but it's actually an award for ageing musicians. Alvin and Kevin pretend to be sick to miss school and sneak off to a convention.

Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleepovers by spending the night at Kevin's house without Alvin or Simon. Plus, when Alvin sees every celebrity with their own personal bodyguard, he decides to train Theodore for the job.

Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol, but her idol only likes her art after Alvin ruins it; Alvin is convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in to their home, so he tries to stop the invasion.

In an effort to be more productive, Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep; Alvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen.
Dave worries that the Chipmunks have become addicted to a video game. A grounded Alvin begs Theodore to buy him a limited edition skateboard.
When Alvin gets hurt, Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a survival reality show; Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's favourite bag and must come up with a way to replace it.

Alvin and Brittany are convinced Simon has vanished back in time and go all out in an attempt to bring him back. A prank call by Alvin gets out of hand when the person on the other end of the line vows to track him down.

When Miss Miller gets robbed, Eleanor and Theodore promise to find the culprit and bring them to justice. Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she so desperately needs to learn.
Alvin gets a lesson in parenting after he kidnaps Simon's robot; when Dave takes away Alvin's phone, the boredom Alvin experiences is enough to drive him crazy.

Stuck inside the house due to a storm, Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand; Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to help steal desserts from the school kitchen using secret underground tunnels.

Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off at the school to Miss Smith. Convinced a zombie invasion is imminent, Alvin and Theodore go all out in an attempt to protect their loved ones.
Theodore must prove he's got the right stuff when the Chipmunks and Chipettes head off to space camp. Theodore burns his tongue on some super-hot chocolate and loses his sense of taste.
Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle over popping acorn tops and bubble wrap. When a cute girl joins the chess club, Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him how to play so he can join as well.
Terry fills in at an antique shop when the owner is hospitalised after a beating from thugs demanding protection money.
Gary is getting ready for Yvonne's return from Korea, but an unexpected arrival at the Royal Oak could cause him even more trouble.
Mr Roper confesses to Mildred that they have had a son for the past eighteen years, at least on paper, but now the Income Tax authorities would like to meet him.
Featuring music from the Police, Pete Townshend, and Paul McCartney.
The best music from the 1960s and some forgotten gems. The soundtrack to New Year's Day.
News, interviews and features for Scotland from the last week.

When Mrs Bridges and Hudson discover that Sarah is pregnant by a mysterious stranger, Thomas the chauffeur offers to marry her, but it turns out that his motives for doing so are less than honourable.
The Prime Minister is coming for dinner, Alf is consumed with thoughts of Lady Lavender, and Teddy's behaviour at the factory causes a mass walk out.
When Mongy the dog is accused of biting a neighbour's child, Mrs B receives a visit from the police and passionately defends the animal.
Harold gets an offer that would enable him to leave the junkyard forever, but his dad has other ideas and does all he can to keep up the family tradition.

Cecil believes he might be Gloria's father and asks May to leave Jack. May confides in Ethel about her past with Cecil. Jack, unaware, resents Cecil and plans to harm him. Cecil learns Gloria cannot be his daughter due to blood groups.
Wedding bells are tolling in the boarding house, but do they toll for Rigsby?
A poker session is taken over by Chrissy when Robin has to go into hospital to have his tonsils removed. Unfortunately, Chrissy can't play poker.
Gary meets his son, Michael, in the present day. After seeing what could become of Michael, Gary attempts to make sure he has a brighter future.
Love is in the air for Jack as he finds romance with well-bred socialist Margaret. Meanwhile, Jack wheels and deals with the South Americans.
It's May 1905 and Elizabeth Bellamy is home from school, about to make her society debut. However, her refusal to conform to society's customs threatens to create a scandal at her first grand ball.
When Thelma leaves Bob and goes back to her mother's, he makes the mistake of asking Terry's advice about how to win her back.
With the girls having convinced the neighbours that everything is fine, on the day Robin moves in, Chrissy learns that her mother, who is no liberal, is to pay a visit.
Gerry Kelly conducts interviews with guests from various walks of life.
Team 'That's TV' present a round-up of the local news for Greater Belfast, Northern Ireland.

When Ron the Burglar opens Arthur's lock-up with a metal comb, he is employed to install the latest high-tech alarm systems. However, Ron is more practised at picking locks than installing burglar deterrents.

Les is down in the dumps as he is missing his son Liam more than ever, so Amber and the staff hatch a plan to cheer him up. Troy believes he is being stalked by his ex Gavin, but when Kenneth discovers that Gavin is on holiday in Venice, the threat soon turns out to be much more sinister. The end of the holiday is drawing near for the Dawsons, and Billy has still not told Sheron that Eddie is supposed to be moving in. Meanwhile, Rob, Joey and Tiger are duped by some fancy dress policemen.

Marty makes a life-changing decision and finds the nerve to propose to Kelly. Over the moon, she accepts. It's time for a proper Chatsworth party, but Kelly discovers a letter to Marty from his kids in Spain. Confused and heartbroken, she calls the wedding off. Will Marty tell her the truth? Elsewhere, Jamie's evasive behaviour makes Karen suspicious; upon discovering a flirty text, Karen fears that Jamie is cheating.
Gary's world is changing fast. Yvonne is changing careers as Phoebe plans the wedding. And Reg's domestic problems threaten his job.
Maurice wants to open a gambling school and enlists Terry and Arthur's help.

Murdoch untersucht den mysteriösen Tod eines Fußballers, während Brackenreid rekrutiert wird.

Die Niederlande im Jahr 1686: Nella Oortmann hofft, in Amsterdam an der Seite ihres neuen Mannes ein neues Leben zu beginnen. Statt jedoch auf den versprochenen Edelmann Johannes trifft sie zunächst auf seine unterkühlte Schwester.

Nella findet heraus, dass ihre Hochzeit auf einer Lüge aufgebaut ist und möchte Amsterdam verlassen. Marin und die Bediensteten können sie jedoch davon abhalten. Sie machen ihr deutlich, dass ihre Abreise eine Blamage für die Familie wäre.

Nella will den Zuckerhandel selbst fortzuführen und Johannes damit retten. Doch im Gefängnis findet sie ihn in einer verzweifelten Lage vor. Frans muss vor Gericht gegen Johannes aussagen. Fraglich ist, ob Nella ihn freikaufen kann.

Der Filmproduzent Henry hat viele Feinde. Die Schauspielerin Valerie wird von ihm erpresst und ihren Kollegen Ralph hat er gerade entlassen. Wenig später findet die Polizei ihn erschlagen in seiner Bibliothek, Valerie hatte die Leiche entdeckt.
Diesmal ist Pierre mit dem österreichischen Schauspieler und "Bergdoktor" Hans Sigl unterwegs.

Im Mittelpunkt stehen die emotionalen Liebes- und Familiengeschichten rund um das Personal und die Eigentümer des Luxushotels "Fürstenhof". Der Alltag wird bestimmt von tragischen Schicksalsschlägen, gemeinen Intrigen und turbulenten Liebschaften.
Kira kann nicht glauben, dass sich Martin von ihr trennen will. Natascha überfordert die Nachricht, schwanger zu sein.

Marlene hat kein Verständnis für Nataschas Entschluss, die Schwangerschaft abzubrechen, ohne vorher mit Konstantin darüber geredet zu haben. Kira hat kein Verständnis für Xavers spontanen Heiratsantrag.

Während Sam um sein Leben kämpft, versetzt Mary das Haus in einen Lockdown. Joe ist fest entschlossen, sich im Familienunternehmen zu beweisen, während Harry mithilfe seines Tutors lernt, seine Gefühle besser zu kontrollieren.

Sam und Mary beschließen, einen festlichen Ball für die Bediensteten zu veranstalten. Während die Beziehung zwischen Edward und Liza immer ernster wird, hegt Ma Zweifel und überredet schließlich Callum, Nachforschungen anzustellen.

Merle stürzt sich mit Feuereifer in die Segelfliegerei. Doch dann erfährt sie von Thomas, dass die Stadt den Pachtvertrag für den Flugplatz nicht verlängert. Ihre Träume drohen zu zerplatzen. Udo trifft die resolute und politisch hochengagierte Marlies und lernt ihre Bürgerinitiative näher kennen. Aus politischer Gemeinsamkeit wird schnell Bewunderung. Janas Freude, dass Maurice seine Eifersucht endlich aufgibt, währt nur kurz.

Jana tut sich schwerer mit ihrem Ehegelöbnis-Text als Maurice. Der ist obenauf, nachdem er Sebastian mit Beziehungen eine Forschungs-Stelle in Texas besorgt hat und ihn so aus Janas Umfeld verbannen will. Jana ist darum nicht traurig, als das Ehegelöbnis wegen einer dringenden OP von Maurice ausfällt. Zutiefst besorgt ist sie jedoch, als bei Nathalie kurz vor ihrer Abreise mit Fabian nach Rotterdam vorzeitig die Wehen einsetzen.

Der Antiquar Michael Hegemann bringt seine Frau Cornelia in die Sachsenklinik, weil sie eine stark blutende Platzwunde über dem Auge hat und über Kopfschmerzen klagt. Dr. Eichhorn vermutet, dass es sich nicht um einen Unfall, sondern um einen Fall von häuslicher Gewalt handelt. Philipp Brentano und Gernot Simoni warnen die Ärztin vor voreiligen Schlüssen. Am nächsten Tag liefert Michael seinen Sohn Paul mit einer Milzruptur in die Klinik ein.

In die Klinik wird ein namenloser Patient nach einer Überdosis Heroin eingeliefert. Es handelt sich um Fabian Althaus, den Sohn von Dr. Rolf Kaminski. Die Verwandtschaft bemerkt jedoch niemand, da Fabian den Namen seiner Mutter angenommen hat. Dr. Globisch kümmert sich um ihn. Als Dr. Kaminski mitbekommt, dass sein Sohn in der Klinik liegt, versucht er, wieder Kontakt zu ihm aufzunehmen, doch daran liegt Fabian nichts.

Dr. Susanne Mertens unterstützt Jonas bei dem Versuch, mit seiner Ex-Freundin Marie ins Gespräch zu kommen. Doch die lässt nicht mit sich reden. Sie möchte, dass Jonas auf jeglichen Kontakt mit den Kindern verzichtet. Auch Susanne kann nicht helfen.

Die Nachricht von der Schwangerschaft treibt Susanne und Christoph in ein Chaos der Gefühle. In die anfängliche Euphorie mischen sich Vorbehalte. Jonas versucht nach einem Besuch von Marie, das Umgangsrecht für die Zwillinge zu bekommen.

Marys Unterricht wird durch einen ungebetenen Besucher gestört. Sie konzentriert ihre ganze Energie auf das Erntefest und hofft, damit einen wichtigen Amtsträger umstimmen zu können. Sam ist außer sich, als Joes jüngster Plan scheinbar scheitert.

Offenbar hat Ma das Haus verwettet - und verloren, sehr zum Entsetzen von Sam und Mary. Harrys Neuigkeiten zur Universität werden von einer noch größeren Bedrohung überschattet, als die entschlossene Imelda versucht, die Familie zu zerstören.

Obwohl Nathalies Krämpfe sich als normale Senkwehen herausstellen, schürt Maurice bei Jana und Fabian die Angst. Aber Nathalie durchschaut ihren überbesorgten Vater. Für sie steht fest: Sie fährt mit Fabian nach Rotterdam, egal, was Maurice sagt. Allerdings hat sie nicht mit dem autoritären Auftritt ihres Vaters gerechnet.

Trotz Udos Beteuerungen lässt es sich nicht leugnen, dass Marlies ihm den Kopf verdreht hat. Der aufmerksamen Erika entgeht das nicht. Als Udo sich auffällig reuig zeigt, sagt Inge es ihm auf den Kopf zu: Er hat sich in Marlies verguckt! Gunter und Ben sind ratlos, wie sie dem Rockstar seine entlaufene Ratte wiederbeschaffen sollen. Johanna lacht sich derweil ins Fäustchen. Als Tiger Rat aber erneut droht, Ärger zu machen, gibt sie sein Maskottchen zurück.

Simon ist sich sicher, dass Samia bei Gregor nie eine solche Absicherung gewollt hätte. Da André sich und seine Vergangenheit vor Charlotte verraten hat, wendet sie sich verletzt von ihm ab. Viktoria sehnt sich nach alten Zeiten. Jana irrt sich.

Während Fiona und Werner nicht glauben, dass Andrés Reue echt ist, hält Charlotte sein schlechtes Gewissen durchaus für möglich. André schreibt einen Brief, in dem er sich entschuldigt. Samia und Simon vertragen sich. Felix muntert Jana auf.

Antonia ist alleinerziehende Mutter von fünf Kindern und muss neben ihren Verpflichtungen als Mutter abends in Bars singen, um ihre Familie ernähren zu können. Glücklicherweise hat sie jede Menge Talent. Vor zwanzig Jahren konnte sie sogar einen echten Hit aufnehmen. Doch nun muss sie sich darauf vorbereiten, dass ihre ältesten Kinder das Haus in Richtung College verlassen. Antonia überlegt, wie ihr Leben danach aussehen wird.

Als ein amerikanischer Pilot unversehens auf der Polizeiwache stirbt, wird eine bis dato ruhige Spätschicht für Will und Geordie zu einer Nacht voller Herausforderungen. Leonard und Daniel überdenken derweil ihre Beziehung.

Während Leonard sich auf seinen Prozess vorbereitet, untersuchen Will und Geordie einen Raubüberfall auf einen Geldtransporter in Cambridge, bei dem Geordie dann unerwartet auf einen alten Freund aus seiner Armeezeit trifft.

Rachel Bromilow stirbt bei einer Protestaktion. Will und Geordie ermitteln im Uni-Milieu und stoßen auf Ehrgeiz und Eifersucht. Ihre Meinungsverschiedenheiten zur CND erschweren den Fall. Im Pfarrhaus sorgt ein Neuzugang für Aufregung.

Frankie is stunned when Mike wants in on one of his brother's crazy business ideas. Axl desperately tries to prove that he is capable of riding his dad's motorcycle. Sue plucks up the courage to confess something to Brad.
Sue's chance at a big date is ruined when she loses Brick, who is visiting her on campus. Mike is down and Frankie brings in reinforcements to find out why.
Each member of the Heck family finds themselves in situations reminiscent of the classic, spooky television show The Twilight Zone.
Sheldon butts heads with Dr. Lee, a new scientist in the lab; Mary is given a lotto ticket.
Sheldon joins Dr. Linkletter and Dr. Sturgis on a science road trip; Georgie continues to lie about his age.
Meemaw's gambling room becomes a success; Sheldon dips his toe in the stock market; Missy starts a business.

Wolowitz questions his engineering skills after he and Sheldon can't get a toy drone to fly. A cancelled flight puts Leonard's plans in jeopardy, and Raj sets his parents against one another after he's cut off financially.
When Sheldon's and Leonard's mothers finally meet, personalities collide. Howard decides to do his share of the chores with a little help from his friends.
Sheldon presses Leonard and Penny to choose a date for their wedding, while dealing with dramatic changes in his own relationship with Amy.
Sheldon struggles to understand what is going on with Amy. Penny must decide if she can get past Leonard's bad behaviour.
Leonard tries to ease Penny's mind, Sheldon plans a special episode of `Fun With Flags', and Bernadette feels bad about keeping a secret.
A flat tyre during Leonard's bachelor party weekend in Mexico tests the guys' skills. Penny is compelled to tell her family that she and Leonard eloped.
An impending change to his living arrangements inspires Sheldon to revert to 2003, before he met Penny and Leonard. Raj and Howard form a band.
Frankie worries that her mum may ruin the annual homecoming tailgate as she decides to attend the event, and Mike asks Brick to help him win the cornhole tournament.
Frankie clashes with a coworker at her Thanksgiving job, Sue offers to work to see a guy she likes, Axl has an embarrassing moment at the bar, and Mike and Brick are bored at home after a blackout.

Frankie persuades Mike to join her on an all-expenses-paid trip to a convention in Des Moines, Iowa. Axl wants to move into Sue's dorm room, and Big Mike watches Brick while Frankie and Mike are away.
Sheldon gets an odd request from an old friend, Paige; George Sr. and Mary are caught in the middle of Meemaw and Dale's breakup; Georgie comes clean to Mandy.
Sheldon copes with the death of a hero; Missy wants to babysit; Georgie struggles with his big secret.
George and Mary insist on meeting the new woman in Georgie's life; Sheldon and Missy have suspicions about what's going on with their family.
Barry Kripke expresses interest in Amy while leading a fencing lesson for the guys. When Stuart tries to attract female customers to the store, Penny, Amy and Bernadette help out.
Leonard and Sheldon go to great lengths to secure the helium they need during a nationwide shortage. Bernadette and Penny try to find Amy a new man on a dating app.

Sheldon struggles to keep his emotions in check when he is interviewed for a documentary about Spock. Penny and Leonard make a surprising discovery, while Wolowitz and Bernadette get into a disagreement about remodelling his childhood home.
Sheldon, Wolowitz and Koothrappali post an ad online to find a new girlfriend for Sheldon. Meanwhile, Penny and Bernadette decide to spy when Amy is secretive about whom she is dating.
Amy and Sheldon spend Thanksgiving at the aquarium, as friends. Wolowitz volunteers at the soup kitchen with Raj, Emily and Bernadette. Penny realises that Leonard knows her better than she thought.

Sheldon is driven to distraction when he can't get a familiar tune out of his head or recall the name of the song. Amy and Dave arrange another date, but Bernadette is unsure about whether Amy should invite Dave over to her flat.
After dating for more than five years, Amy and Sheldon spend the night together for the first time. Leonard, Wolowitz, and Koothrappali must decide what to do with an extra movie ticket.

Leonard agrees to meet with a psychiatrist on Penny's behalf, Sheldon and Koothrappali work together on an astronomical discovery, and Wolowitz and Bernadette struggle with their emotions when Stuart moves out.
The topical panel show with a standup twist is back with a new look! Two teams of top comedians battle to poke fun at the week's news.

Slow-witted Forrest Gump has never thought of himself as disadvantaged, and thanks to his supportive mother, he leads anything but a restricted life. Whether dominating on the gridiron as a college football star, fighting in Vietnam or captaining a shrimp boat, Forrest inspires people with his childlike optimism. However, one person Forrest cares about most may be the most difficult to save, his childhood love, the sweet but troubled Jenny.

Die Brüder Lonnie und John aus Texas sind beide über 30 Jahre alt und wiegen über 250 Kilogramm. Inzwischen ist die Fettleibigkeit so extrem geworden, dass beide an starken gesundheitlichen Problemen leiden. Nun müssen sie zusammenhalten.
Bettie Jo hat keine richtige Ehe - ihr Mann Josh ist vor allem ihr Pfleger. Doch so wie Josh sie umsorgt, schadet er der jungen Frau. Vor ihrer Magen-Bypass-OP wog Bettie Jo 297 Kilogramm.

Sarah liebt eine KI, verbringt 20 Stunden täglich mit ihr und will sich für sie ein Tattoo stechen lassen. Tajah lutscht täglich stundenlang am Daumen, was zu Hautschäden führt, weshalb sie über ein Ende nachdenkt. Sarah geht indes zur Paarberatung.

Pudel Tilly hat einen Stein verschluckt, den Dr. G per Endoskop nur schwer bergen kann. Ständig flutscht er aus dem Greifinstrument. Spaniel Daisy muss wegen Bauchschmerzen operiert werden. Im Darm findet Dr. Suttie ein verschlucktes Dessous.

Die vier Wochen alte Babyente Buddy frisst kaum und hat ein Juteschnurknäuel im Kropf, das Dr. G endoskopisch entfernt. Berner Sennenhund Pepe hat gleich zwei Fremdkörper verputzt. Darunter findet sich das Stück eines Tennisballs im Magen.

Paul hat eine seltsame Geschwulst, die aus seinem Fuß wächst. Es sieht aus wie eine Art Zusatz-Zehe, aber kein Arzt konnte ihm bisher sagen, was es ist. Kiara besitzt einen überdimensionalen Zeh. Die 25-Jährige kann keine geschlossenen Schuhe tragen und hat von Jahr zu Jahr mehr Beschwerden. Kann Fußchirurg Dr. Vincent den Patienten helfen?

Buddy soll für die "Nacht der Spione" Veranstaltung im Casino eine gigantische Torte backen. Er entscheidet sich für eine Agentenauto-Torte mit Spielkarten, Jetons und Würfel rundherum. Alles soll in den Farben rot, grün und schwarz gehalten werden.

Die Giraffen sind bereit zur Paarung und das 4-jährige Männchen Jigsaw soll zum ersten Mal auf das Weibchen Zizi treffen. Die erste Beschnupperung der beiden verläuft erfolgreich. Währenddessen wird das Weißnackenkranichküken Cora langsam erwachsen.

Zwergpinguine kommen in freier Wildbahn in Australien und rund um Neuseeland vor. Die Tiere sind sehr gesellig und bilden ständig befreundete Gruppen. Auch im New Yorker Bronx Zoo gibt es eine kleine Kolonie.

Die verheirateten Besitzer von "On the Bayou" in Milwaukee können nicht aufhören zu kämpfen, und das zerstört ihr Restaurant und ihre Beziehung. Robert Irvine muss ihnen helfen, ihre Rollen neu zu definieren und ihre Beziehung wiederzubeleben.

Robert Irvine reist nach Milwaukee, wo Besitzer Abel das "Mexican Village" betreibt, ein Tex-Mex-Restaurant, das in Schulden versinkt. Robert hilft Abel dabei, schwierige Entscheidungen zu treffen, um sein Restaurant und seine Familie zu retten.

In Greenville glauben die Besitzer eines Flughafencafés, dass alle Kinder auf einem nahe gelegenen Spielplatz ihre zahlenden Kunden vertreiben. Robert Irvine muss sie davon überzeugen, dass ihre Probleme lösbar sind, sonst wird ihr Lokal geschlossen.

Nach dem Tod ihres Vaters übernehmen drei Schwestern das traditionsreiche Seafood-Restaurant der Familie - doch das Callahan's versinkt im Chaos. Die Schwestern streiten sich und Gordon entdeckt verdorbene Lebensmittel, Rattenkot und Kakerlaken.

Ashley und ihr Bruder sind wie Feuer und Wasser. Nun soll sie ihn auch noch bei den Internetverkäufen unterstützen. Außerdem gibt es einen Konflikt in der Elektronikabteilung. Ein Kunde will eine Spielkonsole kaufen, hat jedoch gar kein Geld dabei.

Pfandhausbesitzer Seth Gold ist schockiert, als ein potenzieller Kunde mit einer toten Taube in einem Plastikbeutel auftaucht. Angeblich gehörte diese früher Mike Tyson. Der Mann fordert ganze 1.000 Dollar für den Vogel. Seth ist skeptisch.

Les Gold steht vor einem großen Problem: Alle Computer des Pfandhauses sind abgestürzt. Dadurch entsteht ein riesiges Chaos und die Kunden müssen warten. Ashley soll ihren Bruder Seth um Hilfe bitten. Doch eigentlich ist sie zu stolz dafür.

Pastor Guy Aubery bietet dem Pfandhaus einen signierten Baseball vom Yankee-Star Babe Ruth an. Falls die Unterschrift echt ist, hat der Ball einen Wert von circa 10.000 Dollar. Bei so einer Summe muss Seth allerdings auf Nummer sicher gehen.

Ein Kunde bietet seinen waschechten Lowrider an. Allerdings will er für den Gebrauchtwagen noch 12.000 Dollar haben. Außerdem möchte jemand seine angeblich echte Tiffany-Taschenuhr loswerden. Die Profis prüfen, ob das Uhrwerk noch im Original ist.

Der Goldpreis ist um fünf Prozent gesunken. Das hat einen erheblichen Einfluss auf das Pfandleihhaus, da das Schmuckgeschäft einen großen Teil des Umsatzes ausmacht. Les und seine Angestellten versuchen daher, den Absatz anderer Artikel anzukurbeln.

Paul Bohill und Steve Pinner haben den Auftrag, 34.000 Euro einzutreiben. Ein Ladeninhaber schuldet diese Summe seinem Vermieter. Doch der ist schon 80 Jahre alt, weshalb die Mitarbeiter vom High Court von einem Härtefall ausgehen.

Da die Mieter in der Wohnung ein Sicherheitsschloss angebracht haben, verzögert sich die Zwangsräumung in London. Im Auftrag des Immobilieneigentümers brechen Paul und Ben schließlich die Tür auf, hinter der die scheinheiligen Mieter warten.

In Brixton sollen Paul Bohill und seine Kollegen einen leerstehenden Kindergarten räumen, in dem sich Hausbesetzer verbarrikadiert haben. Da bei diesem Einsatz mit erheblichem Widerstand zu rechnen ist, erhalten die Gerichtsvollzieher Unterstützung.
Kim wagt in England einen neuen Anlauf in Sachen Liebe: Nach drei Monaten Chatten will sie Wayne endlich persönlich treffen - Sohn Jamal ist als kritischer Begleitschutz dabei.
Beim gemeinsamen Schmiedekurs kommen sich Kim und Wayne näher. Doch bevor aus dem Flirt mehr wird, muss Kim ihm noch ein brisantes Familiengeheimnis verraten.

Nach Jahren des Missbrauchs verlässt Cheryl ihren grausamen Ehemann Thom. Dieser verkraftet den Kontrollverlust nicht und beginnt, sie obsessiv zu verfolgen. Als Cheryl neues Liebesglück findet, stellt ihr Ex-Mann eine tödliche Rachefalle.

Ein sonniger Morgen in Florida wird zum Albtraum: Marlene Warren öffnet die Haustür - und steht einem Clown mit Blumen und Ballons gegenüber. Sekunden später liegt sie erschossen am Boden. Jahrzehntelang bleibt der bizarre Clown-Mord ungelöst.
Zwei Schwestern kauften 2019 das Smugglers Inn. Bald hörten sie Geschichten über Geister in der Kneipe.
Wincanton in Somerset ist diesmal das Ziel des Ghosthunter-Trios. Hier wurde eine 4500 Jahre alte Begräbnisstätte gefunden.

In Chilmark, Grafschaft Wiltshire, ist es eine Farm, auf der es paranormale Aktivitäten gibt. Als die Besitzer in ihre alte Heimat zurückgekehrt sind, können sie nachts nicht schlafen, weil ein bizarrer Nebel auftaucht und sich in Gestalten wandelt.
